text:
incident-bot: Paging @sara_oncall — HIGH spike for org=magma-corp. 429s up 16% in last 5m, p95 latency creeping, some 500s. Possible cascading backpressure. Alert: infra.alerts.org_rate_surge.
sara_oncall: on it, grabbing dashboards :eyes:
kevin_sre: looking — I see sustained token-heavy streaming from magma-app-canary, token rate ~3x baseline, nodes in pool at 90%+ GPU util. Other orgs seeing elevated 429s due to shared request queues.
jamie_cs: magma support reporting customer-visible timeouts and degraded UX. They asked for immediate mitigation — willing to accept temporary relax.
sara_oncall: options: 1) emergency increase for magma org quota (reduces their 429s but increases cost/risk), 2) route magma to lower-capacity model variant, or 3) hard-throttle to protect platform. prefer 1 for now to reduce customer impact, with tight duration and canary.
ops-lead: agreed. Do a canary bump (10% of their tokens) then escalate to 100% if metrics look good. Capture runbook steps and retention window.
kevin_sre: proposing command to apply (we'll use infractl):
```
infractl rate-limit set --org magma-corp --qps 25 --burst 1000 --scope org --duration 30m --comment "emergency surge 2779123456" --canary 10
```
kevin_sre: that preserves baseline token_bucket while allowing short bursts. Can run now.
sara_oncall: applying canary now. will post job id.
incident-bot: rl-change-job started (job_id: rl-2026-277912) — canary=10% target=org:magma-corp
(some seconds pass)
incident-bot: rl-change-job update: canary applied to 10% at 2026-03-17T12:03:54Z.
kevin_sre: metrics — 429 rate for canary subset down from 72% -> 18% within 90s, p95 latency stable (+5% absolute). No increase in 500s.
jamie_cs: customer-facing note: "We're running a temporary quota adjustment to smooth your traffic. We'll notify when it's reverted." :white_check_mark:
sara_oncall: given canary looks good, bumping to 100% for 45m. running: 
```
infractl rate-limit set --org magma-corp --qps 25 --burst 1000 --duration 45m --comment "escalate canary->all 2779123456"
```
incident-bot: rl-change-job started (job_id: rl-2026-277913) — full rollout
incident-bot: rl-change-job update: full rollout applied at 2026-03-17T12:06:18Z
kevin_sre: immediate metrics: cluster queue depth down, platform-wide 429s drop to baseline+2%, magma error rate down to acceptable. Watching for secondary effects.
ops-lead: track costs and keep duration strict. postmortem owner assigned: kevin_sre. Please record exact timestamps and commands in incident doc.
sara_oncall: setting alert for any spike in 5xx or sustained latency rise. also enabling request-sampling for magma (2%) to capture payloads for debug.
kevin_sre: sample command: `infractl sample enable --org magma-corp --rate 0.02 --ttl 1h`
jamie_cs: told the customer support team to hold off escalations; they acknowledged.
incident-bot: monitoring window started (45m). next check-in at +10m.
sara_oncall: +10m check — all good, no 5xx increase, 429s low. :thumbsup:
ops-lead: after 45m, plan: roll back to baseline qps=10 burst=200 unless metrics indicate otherwise. schedule rollback at 12:51Z.
kevin_sre: will prepare rollback command and a quick abort plan if regressions occur.
sara_oncall: handoff to next oncall (kevin_sre) for 1h post-rollout monitoring.
jamie_cs: capturing this thread into incident doc and pinging customer success.
ops-lead: good job. keep a tight postmortem (timeline + root cause + mitigation playbook).
incident-bot: incident closed for urgent page — mitigation applied and monitoring in place. + followup in incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
